3namespace Faker\ORM\Propel2;

5use Propel\Generator\Model\PropelTypes;
6use Propel\Runtime\Map\ColumnMap;
7
8class ColumnTypeGuesser
9{
10    protected $generator;
11
12    public function __construct(\Faker\Generator $generator)
13    {
14        $this->generator = $generator;
15    }
16
17    /**
18     * @return \Closure|null
19     */
20    public function guessFormat(ColumnMap $column)
21    {
22        $generator = $this->generator;
23
24        if ($column->isTemporal()) {
25            if ($column->getType() == PropelTypes::BU_DATE || $column->getType() == PropelTypes::BU_TIMESTAMP) {
26                return static function () use ($generator) {
27                    return $generator->dateTime;
28                };
29            }
30
31            return static function () use ($generator) {
32                return $generator->dateTimeAD;
33            };
34        }
35        $type = $column->getType();
36
37        switch ($type) {
38            case PropelTypes::BOOLEAN:
39            case PropelTypes::BOOLEAN_EMU:
40                return static function () use ($generator) {
41                    return $generator->boolean;
42                };
43
44            case PropelTypes::NUMERIC:
45            case PropelTypes::DECIMAL:
46                $size = $column->getSize();
47
48                return static function () use ($generator, $size) {
49                    return $generator->randomNumber($size + 2) / 100;
50                };
51
52            case PropelTypes::TINYINT:
53                return static function () use ($generator) {
54                    return $generator->numberBetween(0, 127);
55                };
56
57            case PropelTypes::SMALLINT:
58                return static function () use ($generator) {
59                    return $generator->numberBetween(0, 32767);
60                };
61
62            case PropelTypes::INTEGER:
63                return static function () use ($generator) {
64                    return $generator->numberBetween(0, 2147483647);
65                };
66
67            case PropelTypes::BIGINT:
68                return static function () use ($generator) {
69                    return $generator->numberBetween(0, PHP_INT_MAX);
70                };
71
72            case PropelTypes::FLOAT:
73            case PropelTypes::DOUBLE:
74            case PropelTypes::REAL:
75                return static function () use ($generator) {
76                    return $generator->randomFloat();
77                };
78
79            case PropelTypes::CHAR:
80            case PropelTypes::VARCHAR:
81            case PropelTypes::BINARY:
82            case PropelTypes::VARBINARY:
83                $size = $column->getSize();
84
85                return static function () use ($generator, $size) {
86                    return $generator->text($size);
87                };
88
89            case PropelTypes::LONGVARCHAR:
90            case PropelTypes::LONGVARBINARY:
91            case PropelTypes::CLOB:
92            case PropelTypes::CLOB_EMU:
93            case PropelTypes::BLOB:
94                return static function () use ($generator) {
95                    return $generator->text;
96                };
97
98            case PropelTypes::ENUM:
99                $valueSet = $column->getValueSet();
100
101                return static function () use ($generator, $valueSet) {
102                    return $generator->randomElement($valueSet);
103                };

105            case PropelTypes::OBJECT:
